title: Better way to play
description: Play the good way ! Many mods to make the experience enjoyable.
body: This modpack adds mods to add a real sense of **exploration** and not just endless, meaningless roaming around. It adds a lot of **structures** to make the Minecraft world more **alive**, with more **stories and depths** than the regular minecraft structures.The modpack also tries to make the game look better and, again, **more alive**.
